description: This file sets up a SOAP web service for vtiger CRM, registering multiple functions for creating and managing CRM entities such as leads, contacts, accounts, tickets, vendors, products, notes, and portal sites, as well as permission checks and session validation.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: A class from the included nusoap library used to handle SOAP web service setup and registration.

methods.name: CheckLeadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit leads.

methods.name: CheckContactPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit contacts.

methods.name: CheckAccountPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit accounts.

methods.name: CheckTicketPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit helpdesk tickets.

methods.name: CheckVendorPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit vendors.

methods.name: CheckProductPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit products.

methods.name: CheckNotePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit documents/notes.

methods.name: CheckSitePermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit portal sites.

methods.name: CheckRssPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to edit RSS feeds.

methods.name: create_site_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a portal site entry from web form data if permitted.

methods.name: LogintoVtigerCRM
methods.description: Authenticates a user and creates a session, returning session details.

methods.name: create_rss_from_webform
methods.description: Creates an RSS feed entry from web form data if permitted.

methods.name: create_note_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a document/note from web form data if permitted.

methods.name: create_product_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a product entry from web form data if permitted.

methods.name: create_vendor_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a vendor entry from web form data if permitted.

methods.name: create_ticket_from_toolbar
methods.description: Creates a helpdesk ticket from toolbar input if permitted.

methods.name: create_account
methods.description: Creates an account record if permitted.

methods.name: create_lead_from_webform
methods.description: Creates a lead record from web form data if permitted.

methods.name: create_contacts
methods.description: Creates a contact record from provided data.

methods.name: create_contact1
methods.description: Helper function to create a contact with detailed fields.

methods.name: GetPicklistValues
methods.description: Retrieves picklist values for a specified table, considering user permissions.

methods.name: unsetServerSessionId
methods.description: Removes a session ID from the database.

methods.name: validateSession
methods.description: Validates user session ID against stored session.

methods.name: getServerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves session ID for a user from database.
